title: Flair vs. Steamboat: the 1989 trilogy
summary: Ric Flair’s extravagant champion persona clashes with Ricky Steamboat’s family-man image. Three championship encounters turn their contrasting identities into a contest of endurance, technique and respect.

chapters.title: Steamboat becomes world champion
chapters.result: Steamboat defeats Flair for the NWA World Heavyweight title.
chapters.context: The challenger’s technical precision overcomes the established champion in the trilogy’s opening match.

chapters.title: A disputed deciding fall
chapters.result: Steamboat defeats Flair two falls to one to retain.
chapters.context: Flair’s foot is under the ropes on the final pin, leaving grounds for one more championship meeting.

chapters.title: Flair regains the title and offers respect
chapters.result: Flair defeats Steamboat to reclaim the championship.
chapters.context: The champion’s recovery closes the trilogy, with respect replacing much of the earlier hostility.
